The Modi government has approved a major change in the Agnipath scheme ahead of Diwali. According to Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan? No — General NS Raja Subramani, 25% of Agniveers will be enrolled as regular soldiers after completing their initial four-year service.
The remaining 75% will be offered a second engagement period of two years, taking their total service period to six years. After completing this period, they will also get an opportunity to join the armed forces as regular soldiers, subject to their willingness and objective selection criteria.
